title: Press-Break Dribble Advance
description: Against a soft, non-trapping press, a strong ball handler is given the green light to simply dribble through the pressure under control.

content.objective: Recognise a soft, single-defender press and advance the ball confidently with the dribble instead of looking to pass immediately.
content.setup: A ball handler receives the inbound pass against a single, non-trapping defender applying light pressure.
instructions: The ball handler catches and immediately assesses whether the pressure is a trap or a single defender.
Against a single defender, attack with a controlled dribble up the sideline.
Use a change of pace or direction if the defender gets too close.
Advance all the way past half court before looking to set up the offense.
coachingPoints: Recognise quickly whether it's safe to dribble through or whether a pass is needed.
Keep the dribble under control; don't speed into a second defender.
Use change of direction rather than trying to simply outrun the defender.
commonMistakes: Picking up the dribble and panicking unnecessarily against a single, soft defender.
Dribbling carelessly into help defense near half court.
Forcing a long pass when a short outlet was actually available.
content.safety: Run this drill at a controlled pace with light, realistic defensive pressure.
